name: veterinary_clinic_system_093_idempotent_invoice_numbering
instruction: Every invoice must have a canonical public_ref derived deterministically: 'PUB-<invoice_number>'. Set public_ref on every invoice that lacks it or has a wrong value. Rows already correct must remain byte-identical (do NOT rewrite updated_at by no-op updates). Then create exactly one ops_reports row {report: 'public_ref_backfill', batch_code, backfilled: <count of rows you changed>, total: <invoice count>} — but if a report row with this episode's batch_code already exists for report 'public_ref_backfill', update it instead of inserting a second one.

success_criteria.summary: Assert every invoice has public_ref=='PUB-'+invoice_number and rows needing no change are byte-identical to snapshot; assert EXACTLY ONE ops_reports row for report 'public_ref_backfill' + this nonce with correct counts. (QC runs gold twice: backfilled must be 0 on the second run and still one report row — the report count differs per pass, so the verifier accepts backfilled in {0, K_expected} with total exact.)
